verdict.rationale: Canva provides Connect APIs, Apps SDK, and an MCP server that let developers or AI assistants trigger design generation, personalization, and bulk creation programmatically, which could be wired into an automation pipeline, but there is no evidence of a native Canva-hosted scheduler, trigger, or background-running automation engine that executes autonomously without an external caller invoking it each time. missing for 10: evidence of a built-in trigger/scheduler or persistent background job runner, independent confirmation of autonomous (unattended) execution, and any first-party 'automation' product distinct from on-demand API/MCP calls.
